title: Oven Roasted American Peppers Skillet
description: A flavorful and healthy weeknight dish featuring roasted American peppers, this recipe is perfect for a quick dinner, it is garlicky and low in sodium.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the American peppers with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the peppers on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
While the peppers are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Once the peppers are done roasting, remove them from the oven and add them to the skillet.
Stir the peppers and onion mixture together and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the oven roasted American peppers skillet hot.
